summary:
The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: `wrap_text` joined the wrapped paragraphs with `"
"`, so the blank line between paragraphs was lost, and it now joins them with `"

"`. The paragraph splitting already collapsed runs of blank lines into one separator, so that behavior is unchanged. I did not touch `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the public API. Spot checks on a few edge cases (empty input, blank-only input, a long word, and a mix of blank and non-blank lines) gave sensible output.
